# X360 Manager v1.6.2

## Highlights
- **Auto-update notifications** — app checks GitHub Releases on startup
- **Version shown in-app** — title bar, sidebar, and Settings → System
- **Fixes Xenia config corruption** on RetroBat / shared installs
- **Language override** + per-game language detection
- **Game Properties settings** apply correctly at launch

## Download
Install **X360-Manager-Setup-1.6.2.exe** (Windows 10/11, 64-bit).

## Updates
The app checks for new releases automatically (Settings → System → **Check for updates**).
When a newer version is on GitHub, you get an in-app banner with **Download** and **Restart & install**.

## Setup
1. Close Xenia before launching games from the manager
2. Data folder: `%APPDATA%\x360-manager`
3. For language: Game Configuration → pick language → **Save** → **Launch**

**Changes since v1.6.1:** https://github.com/Supermedo/x360-manager/compare/v1.6.1...v1.6.2
